text: Given group g1 with member m1 not yet present, When exo_add_distribution_group_member(group=g1, member=m1) is called, Then the response is {"added": true} and a subsequent membership read includes m1

Given m1 is already a member of g1, When exo_add_distribution_group_member(group=g1, member=m1) is called again, Then the response is {"added": false, "already_member": true} and no Add-DistributionGroupMember call is issued

Given group resolves to RecipientTypeDetails=DynamicDistributionGroup, When exo_add_distribution_group_member is called, Then the response is error.code=dynamic_group_unsupported mentioning 'dynamic distribution group'
Given group resolves with IsDirSynced=true, When exo_add_distribution_group_member is called, Then the response is error.code=directory_synced_group_unsupported mentioning on-premises synchronization

Given group resolves to RecipientTypeDetails=GroupMailbox, When exo_add_distribution_group_member is called, Then the response is error.code=microsoft_365_group_unsupported mentioning 'Microsoft 365 Group'
The three error codes used in TC-EXO-003/004/005 (dynamic_group_unsupported, directory_synced_group_unsupported, microsoft_365_group_unsupported) are pairwise distinct strings
Given group resolves to no recipient at all, When exo_add_distribution_group_member is called, Then the response is error.code=not_found
Given group exists and is a usable type but member resolves to no recipient, When exo_add_distribution_group_member is called, Then the response is error.code=not_found

Given a mailbox with a scheduled auto-reply configured, When exo_get_auto_reply is called, Then the response matches the mocked upstream record (state/audience/messages/start/end) and no write call is issued

Given an existing config with external_audience=Known and a non-empty external_message, When exo_set_auto_reply is called supplying only internal_message, Then the captured Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration request contains only InternalMessage, and the post-write readback still shows the original external_audience/external_message
Given start_time="2026-01-10T09:00:00+10:00" (Brisbane), When exo_set_auto_reply is called, Then the value sent upstream is "2026-01-09T23:00:00Z"
Given start_time="2026-01-10T09:00:00" (no timezone offset), When exo_set_auto_reply is called, Then the response is error.code=invalid_argument and zero upstream Set-*/Get-* calls are recorded
After a successful exo_set_auto_reply call, exactly one Get-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration invocation is recorded

Given the post-write Get-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration call fails after the Set call succeeded, When exo_set_auto_reply is called, Then the response reports the write as succeeded with verified:false and no exception is raised
Given identity resolves to no mailbox, When exo_get_auto_reply or exo_set_auto_reply is called, Then the response is error.code=not_found

Given auto_reply_state="Maybe" (not an accepted value), When exo_set_auto_reply is called, Then the response is error.code=invalid_argument naming the accepted values, and this happens before any upstream call

[需求缺失/INCOMPLETE] Design-review check (not a runtime test): neither exo_add_distribution_group_member, exo_get_auto_reply, nor exo_set_auto_reply accepts or forwards any tenant-selecting parameter; all three resolve their ExoClient exclusively through client_factory() (server.py:140-141), identical to the 7 existing tools. A true cross-tenant runtime test would require two real tenants' credentials, which this repo's test suite does not have.
steps: Open the diff for groups.py and mailbox.py
Confirm none of the three new tool functions take a tenant/tenant_id/credentials parameter
Confirm each new tool calls client_factory() exactly like the existing 7 tools (server.py:140-141) and never constructs an ExoClient directly
expect: No tenant-selecting parameter exists on any of the three new tools; all three resolve credentials solely via client_factory()
